mission_baseline.status: user accepted mission direction; detailed spaces, technology and gameplay not approved or implemented
mission_baseline.identity: independent civilization home with no reliable home port to depend on; continuous life and exploration
mission_baseline.history: origin and whether a former home port ever existed remain undecided; migration is only a possible experience or later choice
mission_baseline.theme: why continue living and exploring without a predetermined destination; meaning emerges through care, curiosity and mutual commitments, not a single cosmic answer or score
mission_baseline.continuity: a continuing awake community and relationships take priority; century-scale travel is a major optional design decision, not the everyday loop
mission_baseline.stability: stable residence, remaining and possible settlement must stay valid; no recurring disaster solely to force departure
mission_baseline.exploration: curiosity and discovery can matter without material yield; lack of reliable contacts does not prove an empty universe
